purpose: 六軸收斂：API messages / serializer output / native healthy prompt / prefill speed / decode speed / quality。所有速度指標以 Service API（llama-server /v1/completions）為準。

dimensions.name: API Messages
dimensions.current_metric: 6 類 probes 已外部化成 versioned contract fixture

dimensions.name: Serializer Output
dimensions.current_metric: 6 個 contract cases 全部與 native healthy prompt 對齊

dimensions.name: Native Healthy Prompt
dimensions.current_metric: 6 個 probes 已定義 native healthy prompt，且已接上字串與 token 級對拍

dimensions.name: Prefill Speed
dimensions.why_this_score: 2026-09-01 實測：llama-server + expert-cache + skip-chat-parsing + CGC_OA_ASYNC=1，cold prefill 4.96 t/s。Warm 後 request 2-4 可達 17-27 t/s。CLI 同配置 25.09 t/s。Service API cold start 顯著慢於 CLI。
dimensions.next_cut: Pre-warm prompt 或 persistent session 讓首次 request 也達到 warm 速度

dimensions.name: Decode Speed
dimensions.why_this_score: 2026-09-01 實測：llama-server + expert-cache + OA_ASYNC，decode 8.79 t/s（CLI 同模型 11.25 t/s 的 78%）。差距來自 HTTP wrapper overhead。MTP 模型可達 27+ t/s（需 32GB 機器驗證）。
evidence: scripts/run_n30cache.sh (CLI baseline: 11.25 t/s base, 27.24 t/s MTP)
dimensions.next_cut: 用 MTP 模型 + 32GB 機器驗證 Service API decode 達到 25+ t/s

dimensions.name: Quality
dimensions.current_metric: skip-chat-parsing output correct (no think/echo), but needs full 4-probe validation
dimensions.why_this_score: 2026-09-01 實測：/v1/completions 輸出正確（capital of France → Paris）；/v1/chat/completions + skip-chat-parsing 輸出正確（2+2 → 4）。無 think/echo/循環。但未跑完整 4 probe 套件。
dimensions.next_cut: 跑完整 QA/摘要/completion/streaming 4 probe 套件確認 quality
